notes: 病院 (byōin) refers to a full-scale hospital. Smaller clinics where you visit a local doctor are often called クリニック (kurinikku) or 医院 (iin).
It is common to add the particle に (ni) or へ (e) after 病院 to indicate you are going there: 病院に行きます (I am going to the hospital).
